DELETE_TEMPLATE_COMMENT: <role>: the role the goal names, such as "the developer". <achieves what>: what the role achieves with the deliverable. <kind>: the kind of deliverable, such as "ux". <ext>: the deliverable's own format, such as "md". The example is optional, until one deliverable of the kind is made. <source>: the path, from the best practice's folder, of the deliverable the example is a copy of; optional, where the example is not a copy.

intents.DELETE_TEMPLATE_COMMENT: One for each section of the template, each dependency among sections and the whole, in the order the generator thinks them. <section>: a heading of the template as written there, or "the whole". <When>: the moment a role uses the section, such as "Reading the goal". <role>: the role that uses it, the one the goal names or one that serves it, such as "the evaluator". <get what>: what that role needs from it there. <so that>: what the role is after in getting it, toward the goal, so that the generator and the evaluator judge by that intent; left out where <get what> is the goal itself.

practices.DELETE_TEMPLATE_COMMENT: One for each question, in the questions' order. <must be>: what the deliverable must be for the question's role, in short sentences. <why>: why the role needs it so, what goes wrong for the role otherwise. <step>: one action a generator that holds the intent would still not know, such as a format to keep or a place to look, saying what it achieves; optional. <case>: when the step applies, optional.
